product.title: Acadia Full Day Small Group Tour

description.text: Explore Acadia National Park with a naturalist guide who teaches flora, fauna, and coastal geology while you hike and travel by van. The small-group day mixes Ocean Path shoreline walking with Jordan Pond and Cadillac Mountain viewpoints. Stops include Sand Beach, Ocean Path, Thunder Hole, Jordan Pond, Cadillac Mountain. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
